text.p: West European traders reported a modest level of turnover in the principal markets on Friday.

They said attention was focused mainly on Central Asian descriptions which some sellers have recently been offering at attractive rates for nearby shipment. Fresh transactions have been noted in Italy and to a lesser extent in France.
The Portuguese market has also witnessed the emergence of interest in offers of new crop to meet shipment requirements during the early winter months.

Despite this activity, the overall level of business continues to be restricted by the strength of the US dollar against major currencies and by the absence of a decisive price trend in the New York futures market.
